_doc: Away-team expeditions (scripts/space/expedition.gd, docs/CONTENT.md section 17). A site is a sector POI of type exp_<kind> (data/sectors.json poi_types, `manual`: it never triggers by itself); fly within its `reach` and press E to pick a team and send it down. The event is picked from the events of type exp_<kind> (data/packs/expeditions_1/events/) by the campaign's seeded rng, and the chain of pages that follows reads the TEAM, not the crew. team: min and max crew sent (you may go alone; the soldier is a candidate besides the unposted crew). kinds: label, airless (sites with no air: choices that ask `suits` need a sealed suit on every member), sky (the station backdrop body drawn for it, data/station_modules.json backdrop: kind and palette), color (the HUD marker), blurb (the line on the team picker). The soldier never dies: a `lose_member` that falls on a soldier who is alone knocks them down (hp 0) instead. risk: the share of an outcome set that hurts a team, under which a choice is tagged `low` and under which `mid` (above it: `high`); a choice that can lose a member or a carried item is tagged for that instead. value: what one unit of an item is worth, for rating a reward (anything not named counts `other`; a blueprint counts `blueprint`, special gear `gear`). tiers: the least value of each reward tier; a good wreck pays about `fair`, an expedition that goes well pays `good` or better. The odds are tested and reported by tests/expedition_sim.gd.

planet.label: Planet surface
planet.blurb: Air you can nearly breathe, ground you can walk on, and nobody to tell you which way is safe.

base.label: Asteroid base
base.blurb: Cut into a rock, no air left. Sealed suits, or nothing past the lock.

ruin.label: Ice ruin
ruin.blurb: Something old under the ice. The cold is the least of it. No air.

platform.label: Gas-giant platform
platform.blurb: A mining platform hung in the cloud-tops. The wind is the hazard; the air is thick and bad.
